title: Family Curriculum Night invitation
purpose: Invite families to an evening information session and collect RSVPs
source_message: Dear families, you are invited to attend our Family Curriculum Night on October 8, 6:00-7:00 p.m. in the main school hall. Please RSVP using the link at https://example.org/rsvp by October 3. If you need an interpreter, please call the program office at +1-555-0100. Questions? Contact the program coordinator at families@example.org. Your cooperation is appreciated.
plain_language_notes: 'You are invited to attend' is wordy - 'You are invited' is enough.
'Your cooperation is appreciated' states no action - replace it with the real request.
'Questions? Contact the program coordinator' should name the response path clearly.
